findings.claim: change-cpc-009 edits and deletes generator inputs (shared/launchagents/*.plist, shared/systemd/*) that feed shared/services.manifest.json (created by change-cpc-001) but never regenerates the manifest nor names a reconciliation change, violating C-01.
findings.evidence: cpc-001 creates 'scripts/generate-service-manifest.mjs' generating 'shared/services.manifest.json' from 'shared/launchagents/*.plist' and 'shared/systemd/*'. cpc-009's Scope includes deleting 'shared/launchagents/ai.prometheus.sovereign-sync.plist', editing four other plists, and deleting the systemd unit, but neither its Scope nor any task lists 'shared/services.manifest.json' or a 'check:services-manifest' run. C-01: 'Any source consumed by a generator must have its generated outputs regenerated and committed before the owning parent phase completes... A deferral that... omits the named owner... is a violation.' No reconciliation change is named anywhere in the artifact.
findings.suggested_fix: Add manifest regeneration + 'node scripts/generate-service-manifest.mjs --check' to cpc-009 tasks and verification, or name a reconciliation change per C-01 with the required persisted evidence.

findings.claim: Deleting substrate/kbd-mobile breaks skill-ffi's manifest: change-cpc-002 gates kbd-mobile behind an optional 'kbd-sync' cargo feature but never removes the path dependency, and cpc-009's Scope omits substrate/skill-ffi/Cargo.toml, so the pack will not resolve after the directory is deleted.
findings.evidence: cpc-002: 'Gate the kbd-mobile API surface in skill-ffi behind a `kbd-sync` cargo feature that is off by default' and task 1 'gate kbd-mobile imports... and drop the default dependency' (drop the default, i.e. make it optional — the path dep remains in the manifest). cpc-009 task 1 deletes 'substrate/kbd-mobile/' with Scope listing only 'substrate/skill-ffi/' nowhere; cargo fails to load a workspace member whose manifest has a path dependency on a non-existent directory even when the feature is disabled.
findings.suggested_fix: Either have cpc-002 fully remove the kbd-mobile dependency from skill-ffi's Cargo.toml (feature as pure no-op stub), or add substrate/skill-ffi/Cargo.toml to cpc-009's Scope with a task removing the feature and dep.

findings.claim: cpc-008 and cpc-009 alter the Codex plugin surface (marketplace entries, MCP server registration, install flow) but neither includes docs/codex-plugin.md in Scope, violating C-03.
findings.evidence: C-03: 'A change that alters the Codex plugin surface (manifest fields, marketplace schema, MCP servers, hooks, install flow) must update docs/codex-plugin.md and, where relevant, the CLAUDE.md section in the same change.' cpc-008 edits '.claude-plugin/marketplace.json', 'config/codex-catalog.txt', and stops MCP registration of sovereign-sync; its Scope has no docs file at all. cpc-009 removes '--sharing' from four installers and edits '.claude-plugin/' but its Scope lists only 'site/docs/' and 'CLAUDE.md' — docs/codex-plugin.md appears in no change in the phase.
findings.suggested_fix: Add docs/codex-plugin.md (and CLAUDE.md for cpc-008) to the Scope and tasks of cpc-008 and cpc-009.

findings.claim: change-cpc-003 declares 'Depends on: none' but its own task 2 and open question require change-cpc-002 to have landed first — an undeclared ordering dependency.
findings.evidence: Header: '**Depends on:** none'. Task 2: 'Add git-rev dependencies on kbd-runtime, storage-provider, learner-model, skill-index at the pack commit that includes change-cpc-002'. Open Questions: 'Exact pack commit to pin: the one that lands change-cpc-002.'
findings.suggested_fix: Set Depends on to change-cpc-002-skill-ffi-kbd-mobile-split (or reword the pin target if the intent is any later pack commit).

findings.claim: The footprint acceptance scenario is self-contradictory: the grep is scoped to directories that cannot contain the expected results.
findings.evidence: 'WHEN `grep -rl -E 'sovereign-sync|sovereign_sync'` runs over scripts, shared, skills, tools/prometheus-cli/crates, hooks, and manifests THEN it returns only `docs/integration-contract.md` and files under `docs/decisions/`' — docs/ is not among the searched paths, so those files can never be returned; as written the criterion either always fails or is vacuous depending on interpretation.
findings.suggested_fix: Either grep the whole repo and whitelist the two docs paths, or restrict the expectation to zero matches in the listed directories.

findings.claim: The no-unwrap acceptance check cannot distinguish test code: `grep -v '#[cfg(test)]'` only filters lines that literally contain the attribute, not unwrap() calls inside cfg(test) modules.
findings.evidence: Verification: '`grep -rn 'unwrap()' crates/ | grep -v '#\[cfg(test)\]'` is empty' — an unwrap() on any line inside a `#[cfg(test)] mod tests { ... }` block does not carry the attribute on its own line, so legitimate test unwraps will fail the gate (or the gate is interpreted loosely and is unverifiable as written).
findings.suggested_fix: Use a scoped check (e.g. clippy lint, or grep limited to non-test files / with -B context filtering) and state it precisely.

findings.claim: Verify-command blocks omit acceptance criteria that the constraints declare to be the gate, across multiple changes.
findings.evidence: Constraints: 'the verify commands in verification.md are the gate'. cpc-002 acceptance requires the cargo-metadata absence check and 'substrate/kbd-mobile/tests/wire_compat.rs passes in isolation', but its verify block is only 'cargo test ... --test ffi_roundtrip'. cpc-004 acceptance requires domain_sync (4 tests), wire_compat, the unwrap grep, and audit-all.sh; verify block has only integration_tests and cli_socket_contract. cpc-001 acceptance requires 'npm run validate:codex and npm run check:skills-index still pass'; verify block omits both. cpc-009 acceptance requires test-service-exclusions.sh and a kbd status + typed mutation; verify block omits them.
findings.suggested_fix: Promote every acceptance-criterion command into the verify block of each change, or demote them from acceptance criteria explicitly.

findings.claim: Acceptance criteria require new integration-test cases in test files that are absent from Scope and from every task's files list.
findings.evidence: cpc-009 verification: 'cargo test ... --test doctor passes with a case asserting no sovereign-sync item' — no task lists tools/prometheus-cli/crates/prometheus-cli/tests/doctor.rs. cpc-010 verification: '--test kbd passes including the new migration case' — neither task lists tests/kbd.rs (Scope covers only kbd-runtime sources, kbd.rs command, and the seven progress.json files).
findings.suggested_fix: Add the respective tests/*.rs files to Scope and to the implementing tasks.

findings.claim: Companion-repo verification gates depend on scripts (audit-all.sh, audit-deps.sh) that no task in the phase creates or edits; if absent from the 14-line scaffold, every Companion change's gate is impossible.
findings.evidence: cited_paths: 'MISSING audit-all.sh' and 'MISSING audit-deps.sh'. cpc-003 task 6 verify is 'bash scripts/audit-all.sh' and the Pins scenario requires 'audit-deps.sh passes', yet no Scope in cpc-003..cpc-007 or cpc-011 lists scripts/audit-all.sh or scripts/audit-deps.sh. The spec's own Why says the Companion 'is a 14-line Tauri scaffold'.
findings.suggested_fix: State explicitly that the scaffold ships these scripts, or add their creation to cpc-003's Scope/tasks.

findings.claim: Assessment Q3 (which repo's KBD run owns cross-repo work) was handed to spec as open and is never resolved; cpc-008 is declared Repository: prometheus-companion while its task 3 performs pack-side edits with pack tooling.
findings.evidence: goals: 'Which repo's KBD run owns the cross-repo work: open for spec (assessment Q3).' No change or section in the artifact answers it. cpc-008 header: '**Repository:** `prometheus-companion`', but task 3: 'Pack: remove skills/learn/sync-*, regenerate skills index, update .claude-plugin/* ... run validate:codex' with verify 'npm run validate:codex' — pack-repo work under a Companion-repo change.
findings.suggested_fix: Resolve Q3 in the spec (e.g. split cpc-008 into a pack-side change and a Companion-side change, or declare the owning run and cross-repo evidence rules).

findings.claim: Moving mobile_wire_is_byte_compatible_with_sovereign_sync into substrate/kbd-mobile/tests/ inverts the dev-dependency direction, but substrate/kbd-mobile/Cargo.toml is not in Scope or any task.
findings.evidence: cpc-002 task 2: 'Move mobile_wire_is_byte_compatible_with_sovereign_sync to substrate/kbd-mobile/tests/wire_compat.rs' with files limited to 'substrate/kbd-mobile/tests/wire_compat.rs' and 'substrate/sovereign-sync/tests/domain_sync.rs'. A test asserting byte compatibility with sovereign-sync's wire format needs sovereign-sync (or its types) as a dev-dependency of kbd-mobile; that manifest edit has no home in the change.
findings.suggested_fix: Add substrate/kbd-mobile/Cargo.toml to task 2's files and the change Scope.

findings.claim: Task 3 lists versions.toml in its files while the phase constraints and the spec itself state agents are denied editing versions.toml (human edit only).
findings.evidence: Task 3: 'Prepare the versions.toml [pins] and [decisions] block for the operator's human edit' with 'files': ['versions.toml']. Goals constraints: 'Companion's versions.toml [pins] is empty and Edit(versions.toml) is denied to agents there; new crate pins are a human edit.'
findings.suggested_fix: Point the task's files at the staging location for the proposed pins (e.g. change notes) and leave versions.toml to the operator's recorded edit.
